Products and Equipment

Your kitchen deserves the best, and we spared no expense on our equipment and the products we use. The high-end sprayers and the authentic Italian Wood Coatings produce the finest finish. With these tools, and our system, your kitchen will last a lifetime!

Kitchen Cabinet Painting
The "Experience"

The process takes a week, some factors may change the duration. Day 1, we remove all the doors and drawers in your kitchen. Day 2-3, we work on them offsite in our shop. Day 4, we return to prep your kitchen for painting. Day 5, we return to clean up and hang the doors/drawers. Now it's time for you to enjoy your brand new kitchen!

"Max did a great job painting our kitchen. He literally transformed our room from a dark space to a bright inviting space. Very professional and timely. Would highly recommend his services."

Tom Maidenbauer

"Max was extremely easy to work with. He put a lot of work and attention to seal off the working area. The quality of the work is amazing. We love the results and highly recommend Max."

Luis Ayala in Charlotte, NC 

"The professional quality and standards that Max maintains throughout his work is indicative of someone who is passionate about their craft. We couldn’t be happier with our kitchen and eagerly recommend Max’s services to everyone we can"

Shanon O
